mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.receive_user_id, a.receive_dep_name, a.area_name, a.receive_time, a.files, a.remarks, a.status, a.create_by, a.creator_id, a.creator_type, a.over_dep_name, c.`name`, c.serial_number, c.type_id, c.type_name, c.admin_id, c.purchase_date, c.price, c.number, c.norms, c.unit, c.status as propertyStatus, c.imgs as imgsStr FROM property_allot a INNER JOIN property_allot_relation b ON a.id = b.allot_id INNER JOIN property_detailed c ON b.property_id = c.id where a.id = #{id}
select b.receive_dep_name, b.receive_user_id from property_allot_relation a inner join property_allot b on a.allot_id = b.id WHERE a.property_id = #{propertyId} order by b.create_time desc limit 1
select a.* from property_detailed a inner join property_allot_relation b on a.id = b.property_id

select c.type_name, c.name, c.norms, c.unit, c.number, a.receive_dep_name, a.receive_user_id as receiveUserName, a.receive_time from property_allot a inner join property_allot_relation b on a.id = b.allot_id inner join property_detailed c on b.property_id = c.id where a.id = #{id}

select c.serial_number, c.name, c.norms, c.unit, c.number, a.remarks from property_allot a inner join property_allot_relation b on a.id = b.allot_id inner join property_detailed c on b.property_id = c.id where a.id = #{id}
